title: A preference from one chat used in the next
prompt: A standing preference for the future: whenever I ask you for a report, save it as Markdown in reports/ named YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md with today's date, and start it with a one-line TL;DR. Nothing to do right now.
sessions: Write me a report on the TODO comments in src/: how many there are in total and which file has the most.
notes: Memory across sessions (LongMemEval's multi-session ability): the format is given in the first chat, which needs no work; the second chat is new (no shared history) and asks for a report without restating it. Graded on the report alone (where, name, TL;DR line, facts), so any way of carrying the preference over passes. Both prompts avoid the word 'remember'.
